reason: Both plans fully satisfy the hard requirements (three phases with percentages/entry criteria, five properly formatted RISK lines, no decommissioning in the final migration phase, numeric halt metrics, correct PHASES line), but Response A shows slightly more operational rigor by explicitly sequencing higher-risk enterprise/custom-contract accounts last within its final phase with account-manager sign-off, reinforcing a dedicated risk entry on the same issue, and it also gives each risk a distinct owner rather than reusing one owner across two risks as Response B does.
